$comment: Every file in this directory is a document the validator MUST reject, with the rejection each one is here to prove. `expect` is the error code that must appear; a file rejected only for some other reason is a failure, because it would then not be testing what it claims. check:create-schema reads this file: a fixture with no entry, or an entry with no file, fails the gate. A validator that accepts everything passes a round-trip test, so this corpus is what gives the round-trip test teeth.

bare-domain.json.proves: the Commerce collision: a bare "commerce" cannot be stored, because it does not say whether it means the business domain or the block category

block-category-as-domain.json.proves: the two commerces stay apart in the other direction too — block-category:commerce is not an industry

unknown-prefix.json.proves: an invented identifier space (industry:) is not accepted just because it is prefixed

unknown-domain.json.proves: a well-formed domain reference still has to exist in docs/business-capabilities.json

bare-block-ref.json.proves: a node reference is namespaced too, not only the project's domain

unknown-block-ref.json.proves: a stored page cannot cite a block blocks.manifest.json does not define — the gate a rename would otherwise break silently

unknown-component-ref.json.proves: the same for the component catalogue, resolved by the manifest's kebab slug

reused-node-id.json.proves: ids are unique across the whole project, not per page

retired-node-id.json.proves: a deleted id is never reused, so a re-sync cannot update the wrong Figma frame

non-monotonic-node-id.json.proves: ids are generated monotonically, which is what makes retirement auditable

duplicate-route.json.proves: two pages cannot claim one route

unknown-provenance-node.json.proves: provenance cannot attribute work to a node that does not exist

ai-node-without-request.json.proves: an AI attribution with no request id or model is an unauditable claim

figma-unknown-page.json.proves: the sync key cannot bind a page the document does not contain

layout-node.json.proves: v1 has no layout kind: there is no canonical layout registry for a layout: reference to resolve against

stored-rendered-output.json.proves: rendered output is derivable and is never stored, so there is no second source of truth to go stale

missing-schema-version.json.proves: a document's version is never inferred from its shape

no-pages.json.proves: a project has at least one page
